+title: Add repairLinks to rewrite old board names to the current name
+---
+## What
+divergence.md M9 "checkLinks and repairLinks". After `checkLinks` (^rctvtvc) finds old-name links, `repairLinks` corrects them.
+
+## Do
+- `repairLinks(boards:, reach:, dryRun:)` rewrites each **old name** link to the current name of the board (git key when there is one, else the ULID).
+- It writes only to the named boards. `reach: true` also writes to the boards that the scan can reach.
+- It is a normal transaction: one `undo` reverses it. `dryRun: true` lists the changes and writes nothing.
+- It does not change a **dangling** link. It reports it.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A `dependsOn`, an assignee URI, a body task URL, and a tombstone line with an old name are rewritten.
+- [ ] One `undo` puts back each rewritten link.
+- [ ] `dryRun: true` writes nothing and lists the same changes.
+- [ ] A board that the call does not name is not changed unless `reach: true`.
+- [ ] Tests use temporary folders and temporary git repos only.
\ No newline at end of file

+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m5aq0aqt6wjw2qmrqmb659jz
+  text: |-
+    Research done. Findings:
+    - `Graph.storedLinks(inBoard:)` (CrossRepo/LinkCheck.swift) and `BoardStore.check(_:in:)` (GraphQL/CheckLinksField.swift) give each link and its class. repairLinks reuses them. OLD_NAME links get the new URI `NodeURI(boardKey: currentName, ref: target.ref)`. DANGLING links are reported and not changed.
+    - A write to many boards in one transaction uses `BoardStore.runAtomically` and `runField(as:in:)` with `WorkingCopy.applyMutationRules`, the same as `moveTask(board:)` (TaskTransferMutations.swift). The commit then writes one transaction, so one `undo` reverses it.
+    - Edge patches: `PatchInput(node:add:remove:)`. A remote edge of an old name is always `.unresolved(.remote(uri))`, so remove `.remote(old)` and add `StoredRef(uri: new, inBoard: holderKey)`.
+    - Body patches: `PatchInput(changing:updating:body:from:)`. The BODY rewrite must use the marker rules of `DependencyMarkers` (code blocks and headings are skipped). The TOMBSTONE rewrite uses `MovedTaskLine`.
+    - `reach: true`: the boards of the scan are `related.copies` (request `.allCopies`, the list of `Query.boards`). The answer of `.allCopies` loads each copy, so each copy has a session.
+    - Tests can make an old name with `CheckLinksTests.makeRenamedLib` and `BoardIDTests.setNewRemote`.
